```python cell
import SC


def scanString(src):
  SC.init(src)
  syms = []
  while SC.sym != SC.EOF:
    syms.append((
      'INDENT'
      if SC.sym == SC.INDENT
      else 'DEDENT'
      if SC.sym == SC.DEDENT
      else 'IDENT'
      if SC.sym == SC.IDENT
      else SC.sym,
      SC.newline,
    ))
    SC.getSym()
  return syms
```
